records.question: How many customers are there?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers FROM customers

records.question: How many products are there in total?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_products FROM products

records.question: How many orders were cancelled?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

records.question: How many customers are from Maharashtra?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_from_maharashtra FROM customers c WHERE c.state = 'Maharashtra'

records.question: What is the price of the most expensive product?
records.generated_sql: SELECT MAX(price) AS max_price FROM products

records.question: How many orders were placed in 2024?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_placed FROM orders o WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01'

records.question: How many payments use the UPI payment method?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS upi_payment_count FROM payments WHERE payment_method = 'upi'

records.question: List all category names.
records.generated_sql: SELECT category_name FROM categories

records.question: How many products are in the Electronics category?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products p JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id WHERE cat.category_name = 'Electronics'

records.question: What is the average price of all products?
records.generated_sql: SELECT AVG(price) AS average_price FROM products

records.question: What is the total revenue?
records.generated_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS total_revenue FROM payments p WHERE p.payment_status = 'paid'

records.question: What is the total revenue from net banking payments?
records.generated_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS netbanking_revenue FROM payments p WHERE p.payment_status = 'paid' AND p.payment_method = 'netbanking'

records.question: How many units were sold in the Sports category?
records.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products pr ON pr.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = pr.category_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND cat.category_name = 'Sports'

records.question: Which 5 products have the highest price?
records.generated_sql: SELECT product_name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5

records.question: How many customers have placed at least one order?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers_with_orders FROM orders

records.question: How many customers have never placed an order?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_never_placed_orders FROM customers c WHERE c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

records.question: What is the average order value?
records.generated_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.amount), 2) AS average_order_value FROM payments p WHERE p.payment_status = 'paid'

records.question: How many orders were returned in 2025?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS returned_orders FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01' AND status = 'returned'

records.question: What is the total revenue from payments made in 2025?
records.generated_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS total_revenue FROM payments p WHERE p.payment_status = 'paid' AND p.payment_date >= '2025-01-01' AND p.payment_date < '2026-01-01'

records.question: How many products have fewer than 50 items in stock?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products WHERE stock_quantity < 50

records.question: What is the total quantity of items in delivered orders?
records.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity_in_delivered_orders FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered'

records.question: Which payment method has the most paid payments?
records.generated_sql: SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM payments WHERE payment_status = 'paid' GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY payment_count DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: Which state has the most customers?
records.generated_sql: SELECT state, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY state ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: Which category has the highest revenue?
records.generated_sql: SELECT cat.category_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products pr ON pr.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = pr.category_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY cat.category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: Show the 5 customers who spent the most money.
records.generated_sql: SELECT c.full_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE p.payment_status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 5

records.question: How many customers from Maharashtra placed more than 5 orders?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.state = 'Maharashtra' AND o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY c.customer_id HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 5

records.question: What is the revenue of each category?
records.generated_sql: SELECT cat.category_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products pr ON pr.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = pr.category_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY cat.category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC

records.question: Which product has the highest total units sold?
records.generated_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: How many customers have ordered products from more than one category?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) > 1

records.question: How many customers have spent more than 50000 in total?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE p.payment_status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.customer_id HAVING SUM(p.amount) > 50000) t
